newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar seen firm vs yen and mark in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dollar seen firm vs yen and mark in Asia.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be firm against the yen during Asian trade on Tuesday on steady bids on the downside from Japanese institutional investors and some trust banks, dealers said.
But exporters and investors are likely to kick in to sell dollars near 115 yen, limiting greenback's gains.
"Trust banks and institutional investors will be keen to buy dollars near 114 yen. We have buying orders from investors lined up below 114 yen as well," a trust bank dealer said.
But a city bank dealer said: "Exporters and investors are interested in selling the greenback near 115 yen."
